name: Triangle Images
description: Editorial display panel showing photos masked into rounded triangles that overlap in a row, with the corner radius animating on hover, plus a header and caption tray.
contents: Glass display panel with subtitle badge, title and description header
Row of overlapping rounded-triangle image masks, alternating up and down
Caption tray with numbered labels and corner crosshair marks
behavior: Hovering a triangle animates its corner radius, scales it slightly and restores image color
Row stacks vertically on screens below 768px
